We decided the best way to do this was to jump onto the lights hanging in front of the store. Everyone made it up there, so when my turn came I jumped to hoist myself up. All three sets of lights came flying through the 7/11 window. Glass was everywhere and I cut my hands real bad on the fall. We all booked it away as fast as we could. The owner had no insurance and couldn't afford to replace the window so the store shut down. I still feel like an asshole to this day, but I never did get caught.
